👮 **Wachiman** · 🟡📝 **Consider · docs: The 2026-11-02 entry presents the move to `niway-dev/wachiman` as new, but the workflow was already on it (confidence medium)**

The new Status text says "Amended 2026-11-02: the engine is `niway-dev/wachiman`", and line 126 says "The engine now lives in `niway-dev/wachiman`". Both read as if the move from `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` to `niway-dev/wachiman` happened in this change.

It did not:
- The 2026-11-01 amendment already names `niway-dev/wachiman` (lines 113–118).
- The PR body says the pin moves from `niway-dev/wachiman@v1.3.0`.
- `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml:21` now uses `niway-dev/wachiman/.github/workflows/review.yml@v1.4.0`.

No amendment records when or why the engine moved from `wachi-reviewer` to `wachiman`. The 2026-10-27 amendment explains why a repository rename matters here: GitHub does not redirect `uses:`.

The first clause of the same Status cell still says the review is "now consumed through the reusable workflow `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`", so the cell now names two current engines.

Suggested fix: limit the 2026-11-02 entry to the `v1.4.0` pin, and mention the move to `wachiman` once, as a change that came before it. Also consider fixing the stale "now consumed through" clause in the Status row. Status lines may change under the append-only rule.

<!-- wachi:finding -->

Fixed in 0dbca02f. The Status cell now opens with `niway-dev/wachiman`, and its 2026-11-02 entry only says "pinned to `v1.4.0`". The dated paragraph no longer presents the move as new: it says the engine has lived in `niway-dev/wachiman` since the `v1.2.1` pin (2026-10-31, `9ae51c18`) and that the ADR had not recorded it.

👮 **Wachiman** · **Looks addressed** at `0dbca02`: Confirmed in 0dbca02f. The Status cell now names `niway-dev/wachiman` as the current engine, and its 2026-11-02 entry is limited to the `v1.4.0` pin (line 12). The dated paragraph records the move to `wachiman` as an earlier change that the ADR had not written down (lines 126 and 133–134). This matches `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml:21`. I couldn't check the commit hash `9ae51c18` from here.
